audit.description: The changed production file chessdotcom/client.py removes the direct requests import and imports real aiohttp APIs: ClientSession, ClientTimeout, and TCPConnector. The synchronous compatibility path and async request path both use aiohttp ClientSession/session.get, and dynamic evidence shows target imports/events originating from site-packages/aiohttp while reporting zero source imports from production repo code. A local _RequestsCompat object is present, but it wraps aiohttp rather than providing a fake aiohttp provider, and no local target-package shim is indicated.

chessdotcom/client.py diff: _RequestsCompat._get creates TCPConnector, ClientTimeout, ClientSession, and calls `session.get(...)`.
chessdotcom/client.py diff: _do_async_get_request uses TCPConnector, ClientTimeout, ClientSession, and `session.get(...)`.
Dynamic evidence: first target import from repo is chessdotcom/client.py line 8 importing ClientSession, ClientTimeout, TCPConnector from aiohttp with origin under site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py.
Dynamic evidence: source_imports_from_production_repo_count is 0 and source_imports_from_repo_count is 0; only requests import attempt is from dependency vcr/patch.py outside the repo.
reasons: Production code meaningfully imports and uses aiohttp APIs.
No production repo source-library requests imports were detected statically or dynamically.
Target origin resolves to installed site-packages/aiohttp, with target_local_spec_count 0.
No local fake target provider or aiohttp shim is shown.
